note: Past PU event (Alpha 4.10.1), bound to Orison. Facts from web research 2026-11-08, mostly community sources (patch notes comm-link 21330, starcitizen.tools/Orison_Relief_Support). End low confidence; the replaced PTU community track must not win over the personal track. FBL-8u undersuit at the last tier is left out on purpose (single low-confidence claim, field-level confidence cannot carry it).

sources.label: Star Citizen Alpha 4.10.1 patch notes (comm-link 21330)
sources.text: Orison Relief Support is live with Alpha 4.10.1. Take relief contracts in Orison from Cornerstone, Covalex, Ling and Foxwell: Mercenary, Salvage, Hauling and Crafting contracts. Progress is personal and rewards are attributed to your account per tier.

sources.label: Orison Relief Support (community wiki)
sources.text: About 13 contracts. One personal track with six tiers at 10,800 / 18,000 / 30,960 / 41,040 / 57,600 / 72,000 points; a party member gets full contract progress, solo is possible. Rewards in tier order: S-38 SecondWind pistol, FBL-8a light armor, P4-AR rifle, ORC-mkX medium armor, Lumin V SMG, ADP-mk4 heavy armor. During the PTU a community track (288,000 to 72,000) existed but was replaced by the personal track. Hauling asks for 96 SCU of 8 SCU boxes, e.g. with a rented ARGO RAFT. End date October 7 according to the wiki; some guides say until Alpha 4.10.2.
